notes: Item Tracker alpha preview, the first build. Unsigned, opt-in, and may change incompatibly between previews. Needs OCRX engine v2.1.0 or later for its page in the OCRX window. Built on Ocrx.Sdk 2.9.0.
changes: Added: Item Tracker rebuilds where your Star Citizen items are from Game.log, and labels each one verified, deduced, stale or in conflict.
Added: Opening an inventory screen in game reads the items on screen and confirms or corrects what Game.log says.
Added: An Item Tracker page in the OCRX window lists your items by location, read-only.
Added: While a kiosk or ship locker is open, a status line in game shows the page, and at a known station's kiosk how many items are verified or in conflict.
